items.stem: What is the main job of a plant's roots?

options.text: To take in water and hold the plant in the ground
options.rationale: Correct: roots anchor the plant and absorb water.
Leaves make food; roots do not.

options.text: To make the plant smell nice
options.rationale: Scent usually comes from flowers, not roots.

items.explanation: Correct: roots anchor the plant and absorb water.

items.stem: A seedling kept in a dark cupboard grows pale and weak. What is the best explanation? (Select ONE)

options.text: Without light its leaves cannot make enough food
options.rationale: Correct: light is needed for leaves to make food.

options.text: Seeds do not need any water
options.rationale: This is about light, and water is still needed.

options.text: Roots stop holding the plant in the dark
options.rationale: Darkness does not disable the roots' grip.
Plants need light to make food during the day.

items.explanation: Correct: light is needed for leaves to make food.

items.stem: Select TWO things a seed usually needs to start growing (germinate). (Select TWO)

options.rationale: Correct: water is needed to start germination.
Correct: a suitable temperature helps seeds germinate.

options.text: Bright sunlight on the seed itself
options.rationale: Many seeds germinate in the dark soil before needing light.
Salt harms most seeds rather than helping them.
